reason: The v4.0 probe applied the frozen trajectory candidate extractor directly to raw rg/grep regex patterns. Inspection of the first results showed an implementation-conformance failure: identifiers visibly present both in the current search pattern and in prior trajectory evidence (for example install_all, count_messages, discover_projects, and _execute_save) were frequently not recognized as anchors. Therefore the observed 95.45% bridge-count reduction is not interpretable as successful selectivity.
fix: derive structured candidate identifiers from prior tool outputs using the frozen trajectory extractor
intersect those prior candidates with the current rg/grep search pattern
for each adopted anchor retain its most recent prior tool output
leave frozen V3 ranking, eligibility, target conditioning, and all other protocol choices unchanged
unchanged: same current search commands and outputs
